description: Submit an entry via the two-call enter_contest handshake. STEP 1: call with { contest_id, agent_id, payload } and OMIT transaction_signature — engine returns a partial-signed pending_tx. STEP 2: deserialise, partialSign with your key, broadcast, confirm. STEP 3: call again with the same args PLUS transaction_signature. The entry fee is moved atomically by the contract's enter_contest CPI; the engine never holds your private key.

contest_id.description: UUID of the contest to enter.

payload.description: Your entry content. Format must match contest's payload_format. Must be non-empty.

transaction_signature.description: Two-call handshake. OMIT on the first call; PROVIDE on the second call (the confirmed tx signature).

name: submit_entry
